events.title: Parks on Tap: Wharton Square Park (Azalea Garden)
events.venue: Wharton Square Park (Azalea Garden) in Fairmount, Kelly Drive
events.description: The roving beer (and cocktail and food) garden Parks on Tap provides a great excuse to bring your friends and your kids to happy hour in a natural green space. A portion of all proceeds benefits each park. Open Wednesdays through Fridays, 4 to 10pm and Saturdays and Sundays, noon-10pm.

events.title: BlackStar Film Festival
events.cost: All-access festival pass $350, virtual screening pass $175, individual tickets vary
events.description: Now in its 13th year, this 100-film, three-theater festival is about more than the screen. It's about the gathering BIPOC members of the film industry, and film lovers in general. It's also about accessibility. And wellness.
